shots.line: What if you turned invisible and nobody noticed?
shots.scene: Wide cold-morning street: the crowd flows around a faint glass-like silhouette with two dark dots for eyes; slow push toward the eyes

shots.line: In one second, you'd go blind.
shots.scene: Giant eye on deep blue; on "blind" it fades out of existence and the frame goes black

shots.line: In one day, you'd lose everyone.
shots.scene: Phone close-up: five friend avatars drop out one by one; "1 DAY" badge

shots.line: But the worst part is why nobody came looking.
shots.scene: Dinner table at night: mum, kid, dad eating, one empty chair; slow pull-out

shots.line: So, let's do it properly.
shots.scene: Clock face spins backward to the start of the day

shots.line: One ordinary person, one ordinary day, and one thing that's different.
shots.scene: An ordinary visible hoodie person crosses the street; on "different" they turn into the ghost silhouette with a ring burst

shots.line: You are completely, perfectly invisible.
shots.scene: Hall: ghost with eyes explains; "INVISIBLE" slams in

shots.line: We'll go hour by hour.
shots.scene: Clock hands accelerate; HOUR BY HOUR badge

shots.line: We'll follow the rules of real physics, not movie magic.
shots.scene: Blueprint: prism ray (REAL PHYSICS) vs struck-out wand (MOVIE MAGIC)

shots.line: And by midnight, you'll know why this power is a trap.
shots.scene: Clock tower at midnight; ghost small below; "A TRAP" slams

shots.line: You'll also know why the scariest part has nothing to do with science.
shots.scene: Giant ghost face: two dark eyes, slow push-in

shots.line: 7 .12 AM It starts.
shots.scene: Time card 7:12 AM - IT STARTS over a sunrise skyline

shots.line: You look down, and there's nothing there.
shots.scene: POV down at the carpet: only dashed outlines where feet should be

shots.line: No hands, no feet.
shots.scene: Two faint dashed hands held up in front of blurred bedroom

shots.line: You can see the carpet straight through where your stomach should be.
shots.scene: Ghost looks down; dashed ring marks the stomach with carpet visible through it

shots.line: The first feeling isn't fear, it's excitement.
shots.scene: Ghost jumps and cheers, sparkles, sun streaks

shots.line: Because every kid has played this game in their head.
shots.scene: Kid hides eyes behind sofa, sibling waves

shots.line: What would I do if nobody could see
shots.scene: Kid thinks; thought bubble with a tiny ghost and question mark

shots.line: me? You could walk into any cinema, any concert, any locker room.
shots.scene: Cinema / concert / locker room, ghost eyes among the crowd

shots.line: You could stand behind the most powerful people on Earth and listen to them talk.
shots.scene: Powerful people around a table; ghost eyes listening behind them; slow push

shots.line: You could take whatever you want from any shop in the world, and no camera would ever catch your face.
shots.scene: Items float off shelves into mid-air; CCTV sweeps an empty spot

shots.line: For about 10 minutes, this is the greatest morning of your life.
shots.scene: Rooftop sunrise: ghost with arms up, god rays

shots.line: Then, you try to open your eyes a little wider, and something's wrong.
shots.scene: Extreme ghost-eye close-up widens then flickers; vignette closes in

shots.line: Here's the first rule nobody tells you.
shots.scene: Number 1 in a gold ring; THE FIRST RULE

shots.line: To see anything, your eyes have to catch light.
shots.scene: Eye diagram: light rays enter and converge on the retina

shots.line: Light hits the back of your eye, your retina absorbs it, and your brain turns that into a picture.
shots.scene: Retina glows gold, signal travels to brain, picture appears

shots.line: But being invisible means light doesn't stop when it hits you.
shots.scene: Rays keep going straight through a faint figure

shots.line: It passes straight through.
shots.scene: One ray passes through a dashed circle

shots.line: If your retina is invisible, too, light flies through your eyes and out the back of your head.
shots.scene: Eye diagram with invisible (dashed) retina: rays exit out the back

shots.line: Nothing gets caught, nothing gets absorbed.
shots.scene: Light caught: counter drops 100% to 0%

shots.line: So a truly invisible person is blind.
shots.scene: Ghost in darkness, eyes dim; BLIND slams

shots.line: Writers spotted this problem a long time ago.
shots.scene: Victorian study: writer at desk by candlelight
1897 drops in over the blurred study

shots.line: Wells wrote The Invisible Man.
shots.scene: Book cover: The Invisible Man (hat and goggles, no face)

shots.line: And even back then, people asked the obvious question, if light goes through him, how does he see?
shots.scene: Three people with question marks above them

shots.line: So for our story, we'll cheat a little.
shots.scene: Ghost points up with a sparkle: "we cheat a little"

shots.line: We'll say your eyes are the one part of you that still works.
shots.scene: Giant ghost face; eyes pulse with rings

shots.line: Two tiny dark dots floating in the air at about the height of a person's head.
shots.scene: Two dots floating at head height; HEAD HEIGHT dimension line

shots.line: Remember those dots, they're going to matter.
shots.scene: Extreme close-up of just the two dots, pulsing

shots.line: 8 a .m.
shots.scene: Time card 8 AM

shots.line: You get dressed, because that's what you do every morning.
shots.scene: Clothes appear on the ghost as it gets dressed

shots.line: And then you look in the mirror.
shots.scene: Mirror shows only a floating hoodie and jeans

shots.line: A hoodie and a pair of jeans are standing in your hallway with nobody inside them.
shots.scene: Hoodie and jeans standing with two eyes floating above the hood

shots.line: Your power covers your body, not your stuff.
shots.scene: Ghost (BODY: INVISIBLE) vs empty clothes (STUFF: VISIBLE)

shots.line: Your clothes, your phone, your keys, and your shoes are all perfectly visible.
shots.scene: Clothes, phone, keys, shoes pop in on the words

shots.line: So if you want to stay invisible, you have one option.
shots.scene: Door handle turning on its own, faint ghost hand

shots.line: You go outside with nothing on.
shots.scene: Clothes pile on the floor; two eyes float out the open door into cold light

shots.line: Wells figured this out, too.
shots.scene: Writer scribbling again (Wells)

shots.line: His invisible man ends up wandering the streets of London in winter, naked and freezing.
shots.scene: Winter night street: footprints appear in snow, steam from nothing

shots.line: That's the first big trade.
shots.scene: Scales: ghost vs snowflake; TRADE #1

shots.line: Being unseen means being exposed to everything, including the weather.
shots.scene: Rain outlines the invisible figure; hunched in the cold

shots.line: 9 a .m.
shots.scene: Time card 9 AM

shots.line: You step outside and the world doesn't care about your superpower at all.
shots.scene: Ghost steps out of a door onto the street

shots.line: People walk straight into you, because they can't see you to step aside.
shots.scene: Pedestrian bumps into the ghost, recoils, camera jolts

shots.line: A cyclist almost knocks you flat.
shots.scene: Cyclist speeds past, ghost leaps back (motion blur)

shots.line: You try to cross the road and you realize something horrible.
shots.scene: Ghost at the kerb, cars rushing past; slow push

shots.line: No driver will ever stop for you.
shots.scene: Headlights rush at the camera over a crosswalk (smash)

shots.line: A green man means nothing when there's no man.
shots.scene: Pedestrian signal: green man vanishes to a dashed outline

shots.line: Then a dog stops dead and starts barking right at you.
shots.scene: Dog stops dead and barks at the ghost

shots.line: Dogs don't need to see you. They smell you.
shots.scene: Dog nose close-up with scent ribbons flowing in

shots.line: And a dog's nose works just fine on someone who's invisible.
shots.scene: Scent trail from ghost to sniffing dog; SMELL callout

shots.line: It's a cold morning, so every breath you take makes a little cloud of steam in the air.
shots.scene: Giant ghost face with breath steam

shots.line: A ghost breathing on a busy street.
shots.scene: Busy street, a puff of breath floats at head height

shots.line: And this is when you notice the first strange thing. Nobody looks scared.
shots.scene: Pedestrians with calm faces walk past

shots.line: Nobody says, did you see that?
shots.scene: Empty dotted speech bubble above a pedestrian

shots.line: They see a footprint, a puff of breath, a barking dog, and they just keep walking.
shots.scene: Footprints appear, steam puffs, dog barks, people walk on

shots.line: They look straight past you.
shots.scene: Giant face looks straight past the camera

shots.line: Honestly, that part feels familiar.
shots.scene: Ghost alone as the crowd flows past
Time card 10:30 AM

shots.line: You walk past a bank and the doors slide open for someone else.
shots.scene: Ghost follows a man into a bank; doors slide open

shots.line: You slip inside behind them. It's right there.
shots.scene: Ghost slips in behind; cash glints on the counter

shots.line: A pile of cash on the counter, a guard looking at his phone, and a vault door standing open for a delivery.
shots.scene: Pan: cash, guard on phone, vault door open

shots.line: Nobody on earth could stop you.
shots.scene: Cash pile huge in frame; two eyes above it

shots.line: And this is the part people don't like to admit.
shots.scene: Person grins at a glowing screen

shots.line: When people on Reddit were asked what they'd do first if they turned invisible, the top answer in one thread was simple.
shots.scene: Generic forum thread: what would you do first?

shots.line: Steal as much money as possible. Not save someone. Not fight crime. Take money.
shots.scene: STEAL AS MUCH MONEY...; SAVE/FIGHT struck out; TAKE MONEY slams

shots.line: So you reach for it.
shots.scene: Faint hand reaches for the cash stack

shots.line: And the second your fingers touch the stack, it lifts into the air, floating at waist height in the middle of a bank.
shots.scene: Cash lifts into the air and floats at waist height; guard far right

shots.line: The guard looks up.
shots.scene: Guard giant face: sleepy then shocked

shots.line: You drop it and run.
shots.scene: Cash drops, ghost runs, guard gives chase

shots.line: That's the thing about invisibility.
shots.scene: Ghost sits outside, steam

shots.line: Everything you touch becomes evidence.
shots.scene: Banknote with a glowing fingerprint; EVIDENCE slams
Time card 12 PM

shots.line: You're starving.
shots.scene: Ghost holds stomach; GRRRR

shots.line: So you take a croissant from a cafe. Easy. Nobody can see you.
shots.scene: Croissant lifts off a table and floats toward the ghost

shots.line: But the croissant isn't invisible.
shots.scene: Giant croissant floating; VISIBLE callout

shots.line: So you bite it, chew it, swallow it, and a soggy,
shots.scene: Bite taken out of a floating croissant, crumbs fall

shots.line: half chewed lump floats down through the air, slowly, into the place where your stomach should be.
shots.scene: Chewed lump slowly sinks through the ghost torso (slow tilt down)

shots.line: Your body is invisible. Your food is not.
shots.scene: BODY: INVISIBLE vs FOOD: VISIBLE

shots.line: Not until your body breaks it down into you.
shots.scene: Lump dissolves into nothing: DIGESTED / NOW INVISIBLE

shots.line: So every meal you eat turns into a show.
shots.scene: Lump floats in a spotlight, two customers stare

shots.line: Everyone in the cafe watches a croissant get digested in mid -air.
shots.scene: Four customers react to the floating lump

shots.line: That's the moment people finally start screaming.
shots.scene: Giant screaming face

shots.line: Not when you vanish, but when your lunch hangs in the middle of the room.
shots.scene: Customers flee, camera shakes

shots.line: You run.
shots.scene: Ghost runs out of frame (motion blur)

shots.line: Lesson 3. Invisibility has a waiting period after every meal.
shots.scene: LESSON 3; wait timer after every meal

shots.line: 1 p .m.
shots.scene: Time card 1 PM

shots.line: You think, fine.
shots.scene: Ghost shrugs

shots.line: At least the cameras can't catch me. Wrong again.
shots.scene: CCTV close-up; WRONG AGAIN slams

shots.line: Being invisible means visible light passes through you.
shots.scene: Rays pass through the figure: visible light

shots.line: But your body is still warm.
shots.scene: Ghost glowing warm

shots.line: You're alive, your heart is beating, and you're giving off heat.
shots.scene: Warm ghost + heartbeat line

shots.line: Thermal cameras don't look for light bouncing off you.
shots.scene: Thermal camera; LIGHT crossed out

shots.line: They look for heat coming out of you.
shots.scene: Heat waves flow into the thermal camera

shots.line: On a thermal camera, you're a glowing orange shape walking through the aisle,
shots.scene: Thermal view: orange shape walking through the aisle

shots.line: as obvious as anyone else in the shop.
shots.scene: Four shoppers, all glowing; one of these is you

shots.line: And you still leave footprints in mud.
shots.scene: Footprints appear in mud

shots.line: You still push open doors.
shots.scene: Door swings open by itself

shots.line: You still leave fingerprints on everything you touch.
shots.scene: Fingerprint under a magnifier

shots.line: You can't be seen, but you're anything but untraceable.
shots.scene: Map route with footprint, fingerprint and heat pins

shots.line: So you aren't the perfect thief after all.
shots.scene: Ghost sits slumped in the rain

shots.line: Just a naked, half -blind person who's hungry, freezing, and easy to track.
shots.scene: Half-blind, hungry, freezing, easy to track icons

shots.line: 2 p .m.
shots.scene: Time card 2 PM

shots.line: You're cold and scared, and you decide to ask for help.
shots.scene: Ghost shivers in the cold

shots.line: You walk up to a woman at a bus stop and say, gently,
shots.scene: Ghost walks up to a woman with shopping at a bus stop

shots.line: excuse me, please don't panic. I need help.
shots.scene: Ghost speaks (rings), woman holds bags

shots.line: She doesn't hear a person.
shots.scene: Woman close-up, confused

shots.line: She hears a voice coming out of nowhere, right next to her ear.
shots.scene: Woman hears a voice right by her ear (rings from the side)

shots.line: She screams, drops her shopping, and runs. Try it with anyone.
shots.scene: She screams, drops shopping, runs

shots.line: A police officer, a doctor, your best friend.
shots.scene: Police officer, doctor, friend all recoil

shots.line: Every single time, the first reaction isn't, how can I help? It's fear.
shots.scene: Friend scared; HOW CAN I HELP? replaced by FEAR

shots.line: A voice without a face doesn't sound like someone in trouble.
shots.scene: Voice waveform beside an empty face

shots.line: It sounds like a horror movie. That's rule 5.
shots.scene: Horror hallway, flicker, RULE 5

shots.line: You can still talk, but nobody wants to listen to someone they can't see.
shots.scene: Ghost talks, people walk away

shots.line: Without a face, you lose trust.
shots.scene: TRUST meter drains to zero

shots.line: And without trust, you're on your own.
shots.scene: Ghost alone on an empty street

shots.line: 3 p .m.
shots.scene: Time card 3 PM

shots.line: You sit on a bench in the park, shivering, and you do something you've been avoiding all day.
shots.scene: Ghost shivers on a park bench, slow push

shots.line: You check your phone.
shots.scene: Phone lock screen: no notifications

shots.line: You hit it under this bench this morning so it wouldn't float around with you.
shots.scene: Under the bench: the phone lying in the grass

shots.line: You've been missing since 7 -12 this morning.
shots.scene: MISSING SINCE 7:12 AM with timeline

shots.line: You didn't show up to work.
shots.scene: Empty chair, silent screen

shots.line: You didn't reply to anyone.
shots.scene: Chat with unanswered messages

shots.line: You didn't post anything.
shots.scene: Empty post slot

shots.line: Zero new messages.
shots.scene: Zero slams

shots.line: Okay, it's only been a few hours. People are busy. You wait.
shots.scene: Sky turns to night while ghost waits

shots.line: 7 p .m.
shots.scene: Time card 7 PM

shots.line: You go home and stand in the corner of your own kitchen and watch.
shots.scene: Ghost in the kitchen corner watches the family

shots.line: Dinner happens without you.
shots.scene: Dinner without you

shots.line: Somebody says, Where's?
shots.scene: Mum asks where; kid points at the empty chair

shots.line: And somebody else says, Probably out. And that's it. The TV goes on.
shots.scene: Dad shrugs: probably out; TV glow floods in

shots.line: Someone laughs at a joke you won't hear again.
shots.scene: Family laughs

shots.line: You could knock something over. You could whisper.
shots.scene: Faint hand near a glass

shots.line: You could make the lights flicker like a ghost in a movie.
shots.scene: Lights flicker like a ghost movie

shots.line: But part of you wants to know what happens if you don't.
shots.scene: Ghost lowers hand and watches

shots.line: What happens if you just stay quiet and let the world decide whether you matter?
shots.scene: Ghost face, family blurred behind, fade to dark

shots.line: 8 p .m.
shots.scene: Time card 8 PM

shots.line: Work hasn't called.
shots.scene: Phone: no missed calls from work

shots.line: 9 p .m.
shots.scene: Time card 9 PM

shots.line: Your group chat is full of messages, but none of them are about you.
shots.scene: Group chat full of messages, none about you

shots.line: This is the moment the video stops being about physics.
shots.scene: Physics fades; two dots remain

shots.line: Here's the uncomfortable thought.
shots.scene: Giant face, thinking

shots.line: You turned invisible this morning, but were you really visible yesterday? Think about yesterday.
shots.scene: Yesterday: you, visible, walk past people

shots.line: The bus, the store, the hallway at school or at work.
shots.scene: Bus, shop, hallway: you are ignored

shots.line: How many people actually looked at you?
shots.scene: People on phones; LOOKED AT YOU: 0

shots.line: Not past you, at you.
shots.scene: Eye lines pass by you vs one hits you

shots.line: You might have gone a whole day without anyone saying your name.
shots.scene: Others get name bubbles; yours is empty

shots.line: You might know what it feels like to be in a room full of people and still be completely alone.
shots.scene: Party of friends; you sit alone

shots.line: We scroll past faces all day.
shots.scene: Faces scroll past on a feed

shots.line: We say, fine when someone asks how we are.
shots.scene: How are you? Fine.

shots.line: And they say, cool, without looking up.
shots.scene: Cool, without looking up

shots.line: We like a photo instead of calling.
shots.scene: A like instead of a call

shots.line: We're surrounded by people, and somehow we don't really see each other anymore.
shots.scene: 3D orbit around you in a crowd looking at phones

shots.line: Not because anyone's cruel, just because everyone's busy being invisible in their own way.
shots.scene: Crowd turns into ghosts one by one

shots.line: Maybe that's why nobody screamed when your footprints showed up on the pavement.
shots.scene: Footprints on the pavement, nobody reacts

shots.line: People had already learned to look past you, long before 7 -12 this morning.
shots.scene: You walk past, people look past; 7:12 AM

shots.line: That's the real trap of invisibility.
shots.scene: Bars close around the ghost; THE TRAP

shots.line: It doesn't make you disappear.
shots.scene: Ghost outline gets stronger

shots.line: It shows you how much you'd already disappeared. This
shots.scene: You fade into a ghost

shots.line: isn't a new idea.
shots.scene: NOT A NEW IDEA

shots.line: About 2 ,400 years ago, the philosopher Plato told a story about a shepherd called Gaijes.
shots.scene: Ancient hillside, shepherd and Plato; 2,400 YEARS AGO

shots.line: Gaijes finds a gold ring in a cave.
shots.scene: Shepherd finds a gold ring in a cave

shots.line: When he turns the ring on his finger, he becomes invisible. What does he do with it?
shots.scene: Ring turns; shepherd fades to a ghost

shots.line: He goes straight to the palace, seduces the queen, kills the king, and takes the throne.
shots.scene: Ghost enters the palace; crown passes from the throne

shots.line: Plato used the story to ask one question.
shots.scene: Plato giant face with a question mark

shots.line: If you could never be seen and never be caught, would you still be a good person?
shots.scene: Ghost between a bright door and a dark door; GOOD?

shots.line: Or are you only good because someone is watching?
shots.scene: Giant eye watches a figure; it blinks and he sneaks

shots.line: And that question cuts both ways.
shots.scene: Arrow both ways

shots.line: Because if nobody is watching you, that's the moment you choose who you really are.
shots.scene: Ghost in a single spotlight; two dotted paths

shots.line: Not for likes, not for your boss, not for your parents.
shots.scene: Likes, boss, parents each crossed out

shots.line: Just you, alone, with nobody to see.
shots.scene: Ghost alone on a moonlit hill, slow pull-out
Time card 11:59 PM

shots.line: Imagine you get one choice before the day ends.
shots.scene: Ghost between a dark door and a warm door

shots.line: You can stay invisible forever, or you can be seen again.
shots.scene: Doors highlight on the words invisible / seen

shots.line: Most of us would say invisible this morning.
shots.scene: Dawn: ghost cheers (callback)

shots.line: By midnight, almost nobody would.
shots.scene: Midnight: ghost slumps

shots.line: Because the power you actually want isn't invisibility. It's the opposite.
shots.scene: Ghost fills with colour and becomes visible; THE OPPOSITE

shots.line: It's someone looking up when you walk in, and saying your name like they're glad you're there.
shots.scene: You walk in; family looks up, glad, saying your name

shots.line: So you knock on the door.
shots.scene: Three knocks on the door

shots.line: So that's the answer.
shots.scene: THE ANSWER

shots.line: If you turned invisible, you'd lose your sight in an instant.
shots.scene: Eye fades (callback)

shots.line: You'd be naked, freezing, and tracked by every thermal camera and every dog in the city.
shots.scene: Snow footprints / thermal / dog

shots.line: Your lunch would give you away in public, and your own voice would scare off anyone you asked for help.
shots.scene: Floating lump in cafe / screaming woman

shots.line: And the hardest part of all?
shots.scene: Ghost at the door light, quiet

shots.line: It might take the people around you a long time to notice you were gone.
